properties.description: eth_getBlockByNumber request must contain valid block number parameter before processing
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request: RPC_REQUEST. process(request) => valid_block_param(request.params[0])
properties.rationale: Ensures block number parsing has valid input before header retrieval

properties.description: Fork status check must be performed before response construction for any block query
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block: BLOCK, response: RPC_RESPONSE. construct_response(block) => checked_fork_status(block)
properties.rationale: Fork status determines whether baseFee field should be included in response

properties.description: Pre-EIP-1559 blocks must have response constructed without baseFee field
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block: BLOCK. block.number < EIP1559_FORK_BLOCK => NOT has_basefee(response(block))
properties.rationale: baseFee field must be omitted for blocks before the fork activation

properties.description: Post-EIP-1559 blocks must have response constructed with baseFee field
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block: BLOCK. block.number >= EIP1559_FORK_BLOCK => has_basefee(response(block))
properties.rationale: baseFee field is mandatory for blocks at or after fork activation

properties.description: Post-1559 blocks must always have baseFee present in block header
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block: BLOCK. block.number >= EIP1559_FORK_BLOCK => EXISTS block.header.baseFee
properties.rationale: Data integrity requirement - baseFee absence in post-fork block indicates inconsistency

properties.description: baseFee value must be formatted as hexadecimal Quantity type in RPC response
properties.formal_spec: FORALL response: RPC_RESPONSE. has_basefee(response) => is_hex_quantity(response.baseFee)
properties.rationale: JSON-RPC specification requires Quantity type encoding for numeric values

properties.description: Block retrieval action requires block to exist in storage
properties.formal_spec: FORALL block_num: UINT256. retrieve_block(block_num) => exists_in_storage(block_num) OR error_returned
properties.rationale: Handling non-existent blocks follows standard JSON-RPC error semantics

properties.description: wallet_watchAsset request must contain WatchAssetParameters with required type field
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request: WATCH_ASSET_REQUEST. process(request) => EXISTS request.params.type
properties.rationale: Asset type is required to determine how to handle the request

properties.description: Valid requests must return true immediately before user interaction
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request: VALID_REQUEST. validation_passed(request) => (return_true(request) BEFORE user_prompt(request))
properties.rationale: Prevents fingerprinting attacks by not leaking timing information about user decisions

properties.description: Invalid requests must throw error without queuing user prompt
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request: INVALID_REQUEST. validation_failed(request) => throw_error(request) AND NOT queue_user_prompt(request)
properties.rationale: Failed validation should not trigger any user interaction

properties.description: Validation sequence must check type before address before chain before blocked list
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request: REQUEST. validate(request) => (check_type(request) BEFORE check_address(request)) AND (check_address(request) BEFORE check_chain(request)) AND (check_chain(request) BEFORE check_blocked(request))
properties.rationale: Ordered validation ensures early rejection of malformed requests

properties.description: Address checksum validation requires recognized asset type
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request: REQUEST. validate_address_checksum(request) => type_recognized(request.type)
properties.rationale: Unknown asset types are rejected before address validation occurs

properties.description: Contract address must be 0x-prefixed checksummed hexadecimal to pass validation
properties.formal_spec: FORALL address: ADDRESS. checksum_valid(address) => is_0x_prefixed(address) AND is_checksummed_hex(address)
properties.rationale: Proper address format prevents typos and ensures correct destination

properties.description: Blocked assets must fail validation regardless of other field validity
properties.formal_spec: FORALL asset: ASSET. on_blocked_list(asset) => NOT validation_passed(asset)
properties.rationale: Blocked list provides protection against known scam tokens

properties.description: Image URLs must use whitelisted schemes only (https, ipfs, data)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL url: IMAGE_URL. safe_to_fetch(url) => url.scheme IN {https, ipfs, data}
properties.rationale: Prevents dangerous schemes like file:// or http:// from being used

properties.description: SSRF protection check requires valid URI scheme first
properties.formal_spec: FORALL url: URL. check_ssrf_risk(url) => valid_scheme(url)
properties.rationale: Scheme validation must precede port/host SSRF checks

properties.description: URLs targeting localhost or internal services must be rejected
properties.formal_spec: FORALL url: URL. targets_internal_resource(url) => NOT safe_to_fetch(url)
properties.rationale: Prevents SSRF attacks that could expose internal infrastructure

properties.description: Tokens with similar names to known tokens must trigger phishing warning
properties.formal_spec: FORALL token: TOKEN, known: KNOWN_TOKEN. similar(token.symbol, known.symbol) AND token.address != known.address => show_phishing_warning(token)
properties.rationale: Protects users from token impersonation attacks

properties.description: Response must be sent to dApp before any user interaction to prevent fingerprinting
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request: VALID_REQUEST. response_sent(request) BEFORE user_ui_shown(request)
properties.rationale: Timing-based fingerprinting could reveal wallet behavior patterns to malicious dApps

properties.description: dApp-provided token metadata must not be trusted without verification
properties.formal_spec: FORALL token_data: DAPP_PROVIDED. display_to_user(token_data) => verified_or_warned(token_data)
properties.rationale: Malicious dApps could provide fake metadata to trick users

properties.description: Pairing precompile input length must be multiple of 192 bytes
properties.formal_spec: FORALL input: CALLDATA. process_pairing(input) => length(input) MOD 192 == 0
properties.rationale: Each G1+G2 point pair requires exactly 192 bytes (32*2 for G1 + 32*4 for G2)

properties.description: Input with length not divisible by 192 must cause execution revert
properties.formal_spec: FORALL input: CALLDATA. length(input) MOD 192 != 0 => execution_reverts(input)
properties.rationale: Malformed input cannot be processed and must fail deterministically

properties.description: G1 point coordinates must be less than field prime p
properties.formal_spec: FORALL point: G1_POINT. valid_encoding(point) => point.x < P AND point.y < P
properties.rationale: Coordinates outside field would be mathematically invalid

properties.description: Valid G1 points must satisfy curve equation y^2 = x^3 + 3 or be point at infinity (0,0)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL point: G1_POINT. valid_encoding(point) => (point.y^2 == point.x^3 + 3 MOD P) OR (point.x == 0 AND point.y == 0)
properties.rationale: Points not on curve would produce incorrect pairing results

properties.description: G2 points must have correct subgroup order q
properties.formal_spec: FORALL point: G2_POINT. valid_encoding(point) => order(point) == Q
properties.rationale: Wrong subgroup membership could enable subgroup attacks on cryptographic protocols

properties.description: Invalid point encoding must cause execution revert
properties.formal_spec: FORALL point: POINT. NOT valid_encoding(point) => execution_reverts()
properties.rationale: Invalid points cannot be used in pairing computation

properties.description: Empty input (k=0) must return 1 (32-byte big-endian)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL input: CALLDATA. length(input) == 0 => pairing_result(input) == 1
properties.rationale: Empty product in multiplicative group equals identity element

properties.description: Product of pairings equal to identity must return 1
properties.formal_spec: FORALL pairs: POINT_PAIRS. product(e(a_i, b_i) for all i) == 1 IN F_q12 => pairing_result(pairs) == 1
properties.rationale: Successful pairing verification indicates valid zkSNARK proof

properties.description: Product of pairings not equal to identity must return 0
properties.formal_spec: FORALL pairs: POINT_PAIRS. product(e(a_i, b_i) for all i) != 1 IN F_q12 => pairing_result(pairs) == 0
properties.rationale: Failed pairing verification indicates invalid proof

properties.description: Gas cost calculation requires input length to determine k
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: PRECOMPILE_CALL. compute_gas_cost(call) => k = length(call.input) / 192
properties.rationale: Number of point pairs determines linear component of gas cost

properties.description: Gas cost follows formula: 80000 * k + 100000
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: PRECOMPILE_CALL. gas_cost(call) == 80000 * (length(call.input) / 192) + 100000
properties.rationale: Linear gas model with base cost ensures DoS protection

properties.description: Insufficient gas must cause out-of-gas error
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call: PRECOMPILE_CALL. call.gas < gas_cost(call) => out_of_gas_error(call)
properties.rationale: Gas metering prevents resource exhaustion attacks

properties.description: Pairing computation must match algebraic definition of optimal ate pairing
properties.formal_spec: FORALL a: G1, b: G2. computed_pairing(a, b) == mathematical_ate_pairing(a, b)
properties.rationale: Incorrect pairing implementation would break zkSNARK security

properties.description: alt_bn128 curve parameters must be consistent across all client implementations
properties.formal_spec: FORALL client1, client2: CLIENT. curve_params(client1) == curve_params(client2)
properties.rationale: Parameter mismatches would cause consensus failures

notes: Batch 18 covers three specifications: EIP-3044 (baseFee RPC field), EIP-747 (wallet_watchAsset with security protections), and EIP-197 (bn128 pairing precompile). Critical security properties address SSRF protection, phishing detection, fingerprinting prevention, input validation for cryptographic operations, and correct pairing computation for zkSNARK verification.
